data.severity: Medium: all 25 scenarios have passed evidence and required branch coverage is measured, while 338 of 548 CLI branches remain unhit.
data.impact_scope: FD-035 PM risk-decision CLI and the Tester-to-PM acceptance handoff; measured branch scope is plugins/aiw-fd.py subprocess only.
data.estimated_repair_time: No repair is indicated by the passing acceptance scenarios. Time to add evidence for the 338 unhit branches is unknown and is not an explicit FD threshold.
data.delivery_impact: No delivery delay is indicated for the stated acceptance criteria; retain 38.3% branch coverage and unhit branches as disclosed residual risk.
data.rationale: Tester r3 binds revision 12 and the exact digest, reports 25/25 scenarios covered including S20-S25, 14/14 behavior test methods passed, and measures plugins/aiw-fd.py branch coverage at 210/548 (38.3%). FD acceptance requires actual CLI subprocess branch counts and percentage to be reported, but sets no minimum percentage. The first unittest attempt had two S20 fixture-claim setup failures before behavior assertions; after the fixture correction the authorized retry passed, and the separately authorized coverage run also passed.
data.residual_risk: 338/548 measured CLI branches were not hit. Black-box success does not establish behavior for those branches, all repository-wide behavior, historical-report compatibility beyond tested cases, or absence of undisclosed implementation defects; independent Reviewer scrutiny remains necessary.
data.uncertainty: The correctness of unhit branches and full-suite compatibility is not established by this focused run. No coverage threshold is defined in the FD, so whether a future threshold should be adopted is outside this assessment.
